# Theory: GitLab Sells a Full SDLC on a (Mostly) Monolith

GitLab’s theory is one application for Git, CI, registry, and security. Omnibus is that app plus dependencies as a package. Kubernetes is the same app shredded into services.

## Invariants

1. FOSS vs Premium is feature gating on the same codebase.
2. Runners are the horizontal scale knob for CI, not the Rails app.
3. A small team can run CE; HA is a different product shape.

```text
Omnibus: one node, many processes
Geo / K8s: DB, Gitaly, Sidekiq, registry, runners
```

## What can break

- GitLab CE on a 2 GB VPS with CI enabled.

## How to read this chapter

History, architecture, features, ops/license, lab, when it fits.
